---- BEGIN MEMO DRAFT ----
To: Markus Klein (VP Finance) and CFO review
From: Marissa Cole, Head of Commercial Finance (copied: Maya Srinivasan)
Re: HealthGrid — one-time packaging deviation & surge credit (pilot)

Summary: HealthGrid requests a temporary unbundle of analytics traffic and a one-time surge credit to cover anticipated ramp-related token overages. We recommend approval of a capped credit of $26,000 (one-time) representing ~31% of the 90-day forecasted spend, contingent on: 1) the unbundle configuration being limited to 90 days and 2) HealthGrid signing the 6-month SOW (attached).

Commercial rationale:
- Pilot value: HealthGrid is evaluating Redwood for core inference across multiple products — successful pilot could convert to a multi-year enterprise commitment.
- Upsell cadence: Early telemetry shows a strong likelihood of expansion (internal scoring >70%).
- Cost to Redwood: Our infra model estimates an incremental cost of ~$9,500 over 90 days for unbundled analytics (smaller batch efficiency loss) plus an expected 5% increase in peak token emissions during ramp (~$5,200).

Financial ask (recommended):
- One-time surge credit: $26,000 (covers infrastructure delta + margin buffer).
- Packaging deviation: Allow analytics to be deployed on an isolated worker pool for 90 days; revert to standard shared pool after trial.

Conditions & guardrails:
- Credit capped and applied only if HealthGrid signs the attached 6-month SOW within 7 days.
- Credit expires if pilot is canceled before 30 days.
- No precedent: include clause stating this is a pilot-specific accommodation and not a change to standard rate cards.

Bottom line: The request carries modest short-term cost for materially higher probability of an enterprise rollout; recommended approval up to $30k but endorsing $26k as a targeted amount.

---- END MEMO DRAFT ----

Ben — your infra numbers matched my estimate (see pricing_unbundle_model). Markus — please advise if comfortable routing to CFO with the $26k ask or if you want to move to $30k cap.

Thanks — Marissa

[Attachment: redline_terms_HealthGrid.docx (docx)]
